scope: Actual installed Windows application close/reopen on one boot; unfinished IQ3_S task and completed-result viewing.

source.installation: Isolated normal wheel installation in full Windows host and worker prefixes; all installed module hashes and origins verified.

workflow: Ordinary New task and file/folder chooser; initial paused readiness; one Resume.
First model step read inventory.csv. Ordinary foreground browser scrolling withheld the next request; normal Stop joined the unfinished application.
Ordinary Open saved task selected the same task in a fresh application. Initial paused readiness; one new Resume; original task completed; normal Stop.
Ordinary Open saved task displayed the completed answer and file reference read-only, then Close.

observation_limits.interpretation: Bounded observers retained status/activity and ended after shutdown connection errors; these exits are not relabeled as successful observer termination. Separate retained joins and native cleanup records establish the scoped cleanup result.

retained_preparation_failure.reason: A private wrapper contained a 65-character helper hash. Corrected before a distinct fresh attempt; no task deadline was renewed.

limits: This is an observed ordinary same-boot application restart, not OS reboot, crash, sleep, hibernation or Fast Startup qualification.
The original 900-second deadline continues while the app is closed. No automatic Resume or renewed allowance is established.
No desktop responsiveness, video/audio quality, gaming performance, general tool exactly-once guarantee or full M3/M5 milestone acceptance follows.

The saved read in the first resumed request is bound through canonical generation history and actual serialized message/tool hashes; no complete raw HTTP request-byte comparison or byte-identical old wire snapshot is claimed.
Private machine logs, databases and model assets are not public replay inputs. Public launcher, task, source contracts and the documented operating sequence support a new local reproduction.

independent_review.scope: Independent closed task/native/request/control/artifact inspection and source comparison; no test-suite or model replay. Root supplied actual UI observations.
